note: No species-level identification in the epithet position (matched case-insensitively): 'Abax sp.', 'Lagopus spec.', 'Oligochaeta indet.', 'Probolocoryphe species A', 'Lithobius sp2 {l}', 'Pheidole sp.3', 'Centris spp2', 'Reithrodontomys n.sp.', 'Cyornis sp?', 'Gomphonema type D' and the Kendall_etal_2019 morphospecies codes 'Lasioglossum lassp8', 'Austrosyphus aussp1'. The record leaves FixFormatting() as a marker that RemoveNonTaxa() removes (its historical path): Genus_sp, Genus_spp, Genus_spec, Genus_indet, Genus_unk or Genus_type as written, Genus_sp for codes; brackets and later tokens of such a name are not checked. Until #43 fix_misspellings.r renamed six Brose_etal_2018 'Genus spec.' markers and 'Gomphonema type D' to bare genera, which made genus-level records of them; those rules were removed (2026-10-04), so a placeholder epithet drops the record.
A digit in the epithet position is a code, not a name: 'edwardsii 1.8429' (Makarieva_2008), 'Unidentified 1' (Kinsella_etal_2020). Marker Genus_sp.

A subspecies marker or an 'undefinable' / 'undetermined' word in the epithet position is an identification to genus only, not a species (matched case-insensitively): 'Microtus ssp' (vertnet-traits-sept2016, 3 rows), 'Peromyscus ssp' (vertnet-mammalia-sept2016 1 row, vertnet-traits-sept2016 2 rows), 'Canis undefinable' (vertnet-mammalia-sept2016 2 rows, vertnet-traits-sept2016 1 row). Marker Genus_sp, removed by RemoveNonTaxa(): a placeholder drops the record and does not become a genus-only record (#43, option B; the alternatives A/C1 are deferred). Until #48 these names reached the enrichment as binomials and were listed as unresolved. 'ssp.' after a binomial is the trinomial marker (annotation row below), not this row.

An identification qualifier before the epithet (case-insensitive): 'Zercon cf gurensis', 'Lithobius cf. mutabilis', 'Pseudobodo c.f. tremulans', 'Procapritermes nr. sandakanensis', 'Arietellus cf.'. The record leaves FixFormatting() as a marker that RemoveNonTaxa() removes (its historical path): Genus_cf, Genus_nr or Genus_aff as written, Genus_cf otherwise.

A placeholder word in the genus position: 'Unidentified species 10', 'Unidentified 2' (Kinsella_etal_2020), 'Unid. Chironomidae' (Hrycik_2024), 'Species 1 (Sutherland)*', 'Unknown species*' (Makarieva_2008). Marker <word>_sp, removed by RemoveNonTaxa().

A hybrid or intergrade, two names joined by x: 'Anas platyrhynchos x rubripes' -> Anas_platyrhynchos, 'Tympanuchus phasianellus X cupido', 'Ploceus castanops X ssp?', 'Centrocercus X Tympanuchus urophasianus X phasianellus' -> the genus-level record Centrocercus (VertNet), 'Carduelis sinica x Serinus canaria' and the glued 'Cebus nigritusXlibidinosus' -> Cebus_nigritus (Tsuboi_etal_2018). The name is cut at the x and the record credited to the first name written (owner decision 2026-10-04; the proposal to drop these 139 rows was not adopted).

The word hybrid in place of the epithet, a hybrid of unrecorded parentage: 'Anas hybrid' (vertnet-aves-sept2016, 2 rows), 'Dendroica hybrid', 'Melospiza hybrid', 'Vermivora hybrid' (1 row each). The name is cut before the word and the record credited to the first name written, here the bare genus, which gives a genus-level record (Anas, Dendroica -> Setophaga, Melospiza, Vermivora; the hybrid rule above and #49). Until #48 'Anas hybrid' reached the enrichment as a binomial and GBIF matched it to Chloephaga hybrida, the kelp goose, whose species record it fed; the other three were listed as unresolved. 'Genus species hybrid' folds to Genus_species; a real epithet such as hybrida does not match.

Two or more alternative taxa in one name: 'Empidonax traillii/alnorum' -> Empidonax_traillii, 'Pipilo maculatus,  ocai' -> Pipilo_maculatus, 'Junco caniceps,  oreganus' (VertNet), 'Lithobius cyrt/mutabi' -> Lithobius_cyrt (an incomplete first fragment, left to the enrichment and listed in the report), 'Diptera larvae/pupae' -> Diptera_larvae and 'Fish eggs/larvae' -> Fish_eggs (labels RemoveNonTaxa() lists) (Brose_etal_2018), 'Musculium/Sphaerium' -> the genus-level record Musculium, 'Nais communis/variablis' (Hrycik_2024), 'Sitobion avenae, Metopolophium dirhodum', 'Coccinella septempunctata and Harpalus pennsylvanicus' (DeLong_etal_2018), 'Pacific herring, Clupea palasi' -> Pacific_herring and 'Skate, Raja orinacea' -> Skate (common names RemoveNonTaxa() lists) (Brown_etal_2018). The name is cut at the separator and the record credited to the first name written (owner decision 2026-10-04; the proposal to drop these 387 rows was not adopted). A comma before a year ('Vanhoffen, 1902') is an authority, not an alternative.
Hrycik_2024 'immature tubificid with hairs' / 'without hairs': immature oligochaetes identified to family. Dropped through DropImputed() (#8, #38).
The aggregate (blastozooid) generation of Salpa maxima (Kiorboe_2014); folds to Salpa_maxima.
Two synonymous epithets joined by a dash (Verberk_2020; P. filamentosus is a synonym of P. capillatus); folds to Phalacrocorax_capillatus.

A genus followed by its epithet alone in brackets, an uncertain identification in vertnet-aves-sept2016: 'Buteo (rufofuscus)', 'Empidonax [traillii]'. The epithet is used, as before #38. Listed by name so that a new bracketed epithet is reported (class error) rather than assumed.

A capitalised word, optionally abbreviated, in brackets between the genus and the epithet is a subgenus and is removed (code rule: this row applies in that position only): 'Jaera (Jaera) albifrons' -> Jaera_albifrons, 'Acanthamoeba (Hartmanella) castellani', 'Crithidia (Strigomonas) oncopelti', 'Trypanosoma (Schizotrypanum) cruzi', 'Trichomonas (Tritrichomonas) foetus' (Makarieva_2008), 'Podilymbus (Podiceps) podiceps', 'Leucocarbo (Phal.) carunculatus' (Verberk_2020), 'Tomopteris (Johnstonella) pacifica' (Pata_2025). Before #38 these became Genus_subgenus and were lost as unresolved.

A sex mark in brackets or as a trailing word: 'Calanus pacificus (F)' (DeLong_etal_2010), 'Pergamasinae (male)' (Brose_etal_2018), 'Arctocephalus gazella Female', 'Mirounga leonina Females', 'Phoca hispida Males', 'Callorhinus ursinus females' (Verberk_2020). Stripped, the record kept as the species' value (owner decision, #37); the signs U+2640/U+2642 are stripped by code.

Copepod stage codes, nauplius N1-N6, copepodite C1-C6 / CI-CVI or a bare Roman numeral: 'Calanus pacificus (N1)', '(II)', '(IV)', '(V)' (DeLong_etal_2010). Non-adult; dropped through DropImputed() (#8, #38). Before #38 they fed the species mean.

Invertebrate stage words after a name: 'Brachyuran larvae (megalops)' (DeLong_etal_2010). Dropped through DropImputed() (#8, #38). Two-token labels such as 'Chironomidae larvae' are not annotations; RemoveNonTaxa() lists them.

Vertebrate age classes after a name: 'Mirounga angustirostris Juveniles', 'Phoca vitulina Juveniles', 'Callorhinus ursinus Juveniles Males' (Verberk_2020 pinnipeds). Dropped through DropImputed() (#8, #38). Before #38 they fed the species mean.
Colony form of the rotifer Conochilus: 'Conochilus (colonial)', '(solitary)' (Brose_etal_2018) -> the genus-level record Conochilus.

The colony form of the rotifer Conochilus written in place of the epithet, without brackets: 'Conochilus_colonial', 'Conochilus_solitary' (Brose_2005 through the DataRetriever, 1 row each; Brose_etal_2018 writes 'Conochilus (colonial)', which the annotation row above covers). The name is cut before the word: the genus-level record Conochilus (#49). Until #48 the two names were listed as unresolved.
Isolate origin: 'Paraphysomonas imperforata (arctic)*', '(newfoundland)*' (DeLong_etal_2010).
Population origin: 'Ilybius chalconatus Bulgaria', 'Ilybius chalconatus Spain' (Verberk_2020).

Culture or strain codes after a binomial: 'Anacystis nidulans PCC (Synechococcus', 'Spirulina platensis P', 'Spirulina platensis 1968-3786' (Makarieva_2008), 'Mycoplasma pulmonis UAB CTIP' (DeLong_etal_2010).

The small body-size classes of the Brose_etal_2018 soil food webs, in braces or as a word: 'Lithobius aeruginosus {s}', 'Scutigerella immaculata {xs}', 'Trachytes pauperior{s}', 'Harpactea lepida small', 'Salvelinus fontinalis small'. Treated as non-adult records and dropped through DropImputed() (owner decision 2026-10-04; before #38 they fed the species mean).

The medium and large body-size classes, in braces or as a word: 'Lithobius aeruginosus {l}', '{m}', 'Allaiulus nitidus {xl}', 'Octolasion tyrtaeum{xxl}', 'Harpactea lepida large' (Brose_etal_2018). Removed, the record kept, as before #38. The sex row precedes this one, so '(M)' is a sex mark and '{m}' a size class.

A binomial in brackets after a binomial is an alternative name: 'Aspidoscelis sexlinata (Cnemidophorus sexlineatus)', 'Tigrosa helluo (Hogna helluo)' (DeLong_etal_2018), 'Eudocimus albus (Guara alba)' (Makarieva_2008).

A capitalised word in an unbalanced bracket after a binomial: the genus repeated or an alternative genus, 'Eurostopodus argus (Eurostopodus', 'Anacystis nidulans PCC (Synechococcus' (Makarieva_2008). Listed by name: any other capitalised word after a binomial is reported (class error) rather than assumed to be a synonym.
An alternative epithet in brackets after a binomial: 'Myadestes obscurus (occidentalis)', 'Euphonia musica(elegantissima)' (vertnet-aves-sept2016), 'Tetrahymena geleii (pyriformis)' (Makarieva_2008).
'Phalacrocorax brasilianus (previously olivaceus)' (Verberk_2020).
The common name in brackets: 'Anhinga rufa (anhinga)' (Makarieva_2008).
An abbreviated author after the binomial: 'Apis mellifera L.' (Brose_etal_2018), 'Phormidium autumnale Gom.', 'Nostoc muscorum G.' (Makarieva_2008).
An author and year, in brackets or trailing: 'Genus species (Gmelin, 1789)', 'Nausithoe rubra Vanhoffen, 1902'. None in the current frames; kept for new sources and the tests.

An infraspecific rank marker after a binomial: 'Cocconeis placentula var. euglypta', 'Fragilaria capucina var. capucina' (Brose_etal_2018), 'Formica fusca var. subaenescens', 'Nostoc commune var.' (Makarieva_2008), 'Dendroica coronata sp.' (McCoy_2008). The marker is removed and the lowercase epithet that may follow folds into the species (code rule for every lowercase trailing token; 'Acanthiza pusilla apicalis' -> Acanthiza_pusilla).

A species group or aggregate marker after a binomial: 'Polypedilum halterale group', 'Heterotrissocladius marcidus group' (Hrycik_2024), 'Hylaeus modestus grp', 'Lasioglossum tegulare grp' (Kendall_etal_2019). The marker is removed and the record credited to the nominal species written before it (owner decision 2026-10-04; the proposal to drop them like cf. was not adopted).
